title: Hwa-Rang

symbol.name: Hwa-Rang
symbol.meaning: The Hwarang youth corps · ITF pattern 8 of 24

note.p: Hwa-Rang is named after the Hwarang, a corps of young men of the Silla kingdom that began in the early 7th century. The 29 movements stand for the 29th Infantry Division, where taekwondo grew up. The diagram is I. You start feet together in the middle of the A–B line facing D: a palm pushing block and two punches in sitting stance; a twin forearm block, upward punch, side punch, knife-hand downward strike and punch toward A; low block, punches and a side kick down the stem toward D; guarding blocks, a fingertip thrust and two fast turning kicks on the E–F line; punches in L-stance and an X-fist pressing block back toward C, ending with an elbow thrust; then side front blocks in closed stance and guarding blocks to B and A.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (29 movements; the side kick and knife-hand strike of 12, and the second turning kick and guarding block of 19, are split into -1 and -2 here). Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; E and F are the ends of the far line, DF and CF the diagonals the turning kicks go toward. Finish by bringing the right foot back to close ready stance C.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre of the A–B line facing D in close ready stance C: feet together, the left hand wrapped over the right fist, held low in front of the abdomen.
Move the left foot to B into a sitting stance facing D. Left palm middle pushing block toward D.
In the same stance, right middle punch toward D.
In the same stance, left middle punch toward D.
Pivoting on the left foot, turn right into a left L-stance facing A (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Twin forearm block.
In the same stance, left upward punch, pulling the right side fist in front of the left shoulder.
Slide toward A into a right fixed stance (right foot forward). Right middle side punch.
Pull the right foot back into a left vertical stance facing A (right foot forward, the left foot back). Right knife-hand downward strike.
Move the left foot to A into a left walking stance. Left middle punch.
Turn left: move the left foot to D into a left walking stance facing D. Left forearm low block.
Step the right foot forward toward D into a right walking stance. Right middle punch.
Pull the left foot to the right foot, turning side-on to D. The left palm on the right fist, the right elbow bent outward.
Right middle side piercing kick toward D, pulling both hands apart.
Lower the right foot toward D into a left L-stance (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right knife-hand middle outward strike.
Step the left foot forward toward D into a left walking stance. Left middle punch.
Step the right foot forward toward D into a right walking stance. Right middle punch, with a kihap.
Turn 270° counter-clockwise: move the left foot round to E into a right L-stance facing E (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Step the right foot forward toward E into a right walking stance. Right straight fingertip middle thrust.
Move the right foot back along the E–F line, turning into a right L-stance facing F (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Right high turning kick toward DF, then lower the right foot toward F.
Left high turning kick toward CF, fast after 18.
Land the left foot toward F, into a right L-stance facing F (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Turn left: move the left foot to C into a left walking stance facing C. Left forearm low block.
Pull the left foot back into a right L-stance facing C (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Right middle punch.
Step the right foot forward toward C into a left L-stance (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Left middle punch.
Step the left foot forward toward C into a right L-stance (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Right middle punch.
Slip the left foot forward toward C into a left walking stance. X-fist pressing block.
Slide the right foot toward C into a right L-stance facing D (left foot toward D, weight on the right leg). Right side elbow thrust back toward C, with a kihap.
Bring the left foot to the right foot, turning counter-clockwise into a closed stance facing B. Right inner forearm side front block, the left forearm extended down to the side.
In the same stance, left inner forearm side front block, the right forearm extended down to the side.
Move the left foot to B into a right L-stance facing B (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Bring the left foot to the right foot, then move the right foot to A into a left L-stance facing A (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
